verdict.rationale: No evidence of anomaly/outlier detection features (e.g., seasonal baselining, ML-based alerting) in the docs; alerting is described only in terms of thresholds, log counts, or patterns (signoz-docs-9), not statistical anomaly detection. The AI/MCP use-cases mention 'Tune a Noisy Alert' but this is a natural-language assistant workflow, not automated anomaly detection replacing thresholds.
